[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Reggis Thine''' was a [[Security guard/Legends|security officer]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], he patrolled [[Kuat Central Plaza]] on [[Kuat Passenger Port]], a transfer [[Space station/Legends|station]] located in the [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]].

==Biography==
As a [[Security guard/Legends|security officer]] on a transfer [[Space station/Legends|station]] located in the [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]], [[Kuat Passenger Port]], [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] Reggis Thine's job was to patrol [[Kuat Central Plaza]]. He had to monitor suspicious activity on the station, help to resolve disputes between passengers and Plaza staff, and evict people who were loitering on the station swindling passengers. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had hired Thine as a security [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] on the station, and he always reported suspicious [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] activity, but he did not care about the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|galactic conflict]] as long as he could patrol the station in peace.<ref name="PSpG" />

==Personality and traits==
Thine was very knowledgeable about everything that occurred in Kuat Central Plaza, and as long as someone was not involved in anything illegal, he would help out lost and confused travelers, as well as give tips on where to get inexpensive [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], lodging, or where to get a passenger [[Transport/Legends|transport]] job. Despite working for the Empire, Thine cared little for the state of the overall [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] unless it affected his patrol of Kuat Central Plaza.<ref name="PSpG" />

==Equipment==
Thine carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], and [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] while on patrol.<ref name="PSpG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Reggis Thine was created as one of the characters to be used on Kuat Passenger Port for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' expansion ''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]'', which was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]].<ref name="PSpG" />
